 Judgment

The respondents are the appellants in this appeal.
They are challenging the enhancement granted by the Reference Court in a reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
An extent of 0.20 Ares of land was acquired from the claimants for widening of Kundamankadavu bridge as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 15.11.2010.
The Land Acquisition Officer granted compensation fixing the land value at the rate of Rs.3,09,406/- per Are.
On reference, the Reference Court granted compensation fixing the land value at Rs.14,85,149/- per Are.
The Reference Court relied on Ext.A1 judgment of the same Court in L.A.R. No.161 of 2012 with respect to the same acquisition.
The learned Senior Government Pleader Smt.Rekha.C.Nair confirmed that the State has not filed any appeal against Ext.A1 judgment and it has become final.
In view of the fact that Ext.A1 has become final, this Court is not justified in interfering with the judgment passed by the Reference Court which relied on Ext.A1 judgment.
2. Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed without costs.

Sd/-
